@graph.name: Is a Fresho alternative what we actually need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not. Fresho is an operations system built for perishable wholesale, from the order to the payment, and replacing it to change how a few kitchens order would be out of scale. Keep it, and bring in VoiceOrder Solutions for the kitchens happier talking than typing.

@graph.name: Is VoiceOrder Solutions better than Fresho?

acceptedAnswer.text: At delivery runs, invoicing, taking payment, picking, margin control or reporting, not remotely: we do none of them. Where we help is narrower, a kitchen that speaks its order and checks every item before it sends. That runs alongside everything Fresho does rather than competing with it.

@graph.name: Their AI handles voicemails. Do we need yours too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maybe not for every account, and it is worth being exact because both products involve a voice. Theirs reads a voicemail your customer already left and works the order out of it. Ours has the customer speak into an app that builds the lines from their guide, which they then confirm. That difference, not a missing feature, is why a Fresho alternative search sometimes ends with both.

@graph.name: Does VoiceOrder Solutions connect to Fresho?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Nothing connects the two, and neither company supports the other. Both sit beside your ERP on their own terms: theirs through its own ERP connection, ours by email, EDI, API or QuickBooks. Neither one passes orders to the other.

@graph.name: Do our customers have to change what they do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only the ones you choose. OrderPilot's published promise is that customers carry on ordering exactly as they always have, and the Fresho portal is there too. Let each account pick: our app suits the kitchens that prefer to talk. One limit: a call or a voicemail to your desk gets no number, no timestamp and nothing moving against stock from us. Only what comes through our app does.

@graph.name: How fast could this be running?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most distributors this takes 24 to 48 hours, and most kitchens have ordered by the end of day one. There are no modules to scope, and nothing in Fresho changes while the first accounts start.

They are the most open about this of anyone we look at: a published starting figure, a setup fee, worked examples and a calculator, with prices by region. We publish nothing and give you a quote instead. Since Fresho stays, ask us to quote just our part.

@graph.name: Where do the Fresho details on this page come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read off fresho.com as it stood on 10 October 2026: the modules they list, the order automation description, the category guides and the pricing page. Their saving figures and review scores belong to them and are not repeated here as results. If any of it has changed, the mistake is at our end.
